about: What Moog's Structure Lib does to a mod's data, and from which MSL release, per Minecraft version. check_data_formats reads a mod's files the way the game does with the oldest MSL the mod allows on each version: the higher of the mod's declared moogs_structures minimum and the oldest MSL build published for that version.
oldest_build_source: Modrinth project 1oUDhxuy (Moog's Structure Lib), every published version, read 2026-11-08. A version not listed falls back to the newest one that is.

legacy_data_upgrade.what: rewrites pre-26.3 data on load: block states, spawn override counts, loot function ids, conditions, typeless number ranges (core/msl_upgrade.py)
legacy_data_upgrade.source: compat/LegacyDataUpgrader.java and mixins/resources/RegistryLoadTaskMixin.java, both '//? if >=26.3'; first in tag 3.3.0-26.3 (commit 2b31c44), unchanged through 3.4.2

trial_spawner_configs.what: reads data/<ns>/trial_spawner/*.json where vanilla does not (before 1.21.2) and writes the config inline when its processor places the spawner
trial_spawner_configs.source: misc/trialspawnerconfig/TrialSpawnerConfigManager.java ('//? if >=1.21.1 <26.1.2') and world/processors/TrialSpawnerRandomizingProcessor.java; first in tag 1.21.1-3.0.0 (commit 02c2aed). The JSON is copied to NBT as it is: mob data is not upgraded
